title: parse_ws_frame sentinel string for missing @type is surprising
description: ws/mod.rs parse_ws_frame (lines 117-122): uses "<no @type>" as a sentinel string for the case where the @type field is absent. WsFrame::Unknown { type_name } callers who log or match on type_name get a confusing synthetic value that looks like an angle-bracket XML tag. Suggested rewrite: change type_name field to Option<String> so absent-@type and unrecognized-@type are distinguishable, or add a separate WsFrame::NoType variant. The current design conflates two distinct cases.
